snippet.title: Mario & Luigi: Brothership sets sail November 7th (Nintendo Switch)
snippet.description:
All hands on deck! A new RPG adventure starring the Mario Bros. is setting sail for Nintendo Switch. Mario & Luigi: Brothership launches November 7th.
